Title: Log Shipping backup copy and restore lag
Purpose: Create one bounded synthetic Log Shipping configuration on CTR-PAIR, prove one healthy backup-copy-restore cycle, then leave exactly one later log backup pending so the framework can report visible lag without relying on a network fault or exact elapsed time.

Arrange.Action: Create only the synthetic LabLs001 database, exact Log Shipping jobs, local monitor rows, and scenario-owned transfer directories on the active CTR-PAIR run.
Arrange.CompletionSignal: The primary and secondary use the same run-owned configuration, the secondary is initialized with NORECOVERY, and every exact job and database identifier is known.

Act.Action: Run one ordered backup-copy-restore cycle, verify matching file evidence, then run one later backup without executing copy or restore.
Act.CompletionSignal: The primary monitor references a newer backup file while the secondary copy and restore monitors still reference the previously verified healthy-cycle file.

Observe.Scope: Only the synthetic LabLs001 database and exact LAB_LS_001 backup, copy, and restore jobs on the active run-owned primary and secondary containers.

AlternativeEvidence: File timestamps and age values may be zero or differ by host timing; ordered monitor-file identity is the portable evidence.
ExpectedFindings.AssertionBoundary: Assert the ordered file relationship and analyzer availability, not an exact lag duration, job runtime, file timestamp, LSN, row ordering, or throughput value.

AlternativeEvidence: The primary latest backup leaf name differs from the unchanged secondary copied and restored leaf name after a previously matching healthy cycle.

Cleanup.Action: Delete only the exact Log Shipping configuration and jobs, drop only LabLs001 on each run-owned container, and remove only the marker-verified LAB-LS-001 transfer directory.
Cleanup.CompletionSignal: No exact scenario job, Log Shipping metadata row, synthetic database, or scenario-owned transfer file remains.

KnownLimitations: This scenario validates Log Shipping metadata and analyzer behavior; it is not a disaster-recovery timing benchmark.
Repository CI validates the bounded action contract. Native Docker and SQL Server 2019, 2022, and 2025 evidence remains an external gate.
